# OpenAlfred

> Open-source, self-hosted AI study assistant for students and self-learners; a proactive personal AI agent with long-term memory, multimodal RAG over personal notes, voice calls, email and task management, and AI-generated mini-apps. Built with Python, FastAPI, LangGraph, and LangChain; supports configured cloud LLMs and local Ollama models.

Chinese name and search terms: OpenAlfred，开源 AI 私人助理，主动式智能体，长期记忆，图文知识库，学习助手，学生 AI 助手，大学生学习助手，课堂笔记问答，课件检索，备考复习，学习计划，作业截止提醒，专注监督，自托管，语音助手，自然语言生成小程序。

## Project

- [Repository and Chinese README](https://github.com/codehuang0717/OpenAlfred): features, product demo, architecture, and setup.
- [English README](https://github.com/codehuang0717/OpenAlfred/blob/master/README.en.md): capabilities and deployment boundaries.
- [Web frontend](https://github.com/codehuang0717/OpenAlfred-WebUI): separate web interface repository.
- [License](https://github.com/codehuang0717/OpenAlfred#license): license declaration in the project README.

## Capability map

- Proactive AI agent: scheduled reminders and opt-in supervision using task context and recent screen activity. Push and SIP calls require configuration.
- Long-term memory: user-scoped preferences, facts, habits, and relationship notes reused across conversations.
- Multimodal RAG: Markdown / PDF knowledge retrieval with source references and original note images; personal knowledge base and study-assistant use cases.
- Voice agent: STT → LLM → TTS with LiveKit and SIP, rather than a claim of native speech-to-speech inference.
- Generative UI: natural-language generation of standalone browser mini-apps, followed by user preview and publishing to a personal toolbox.
- Productivity: todos, reminders, IMAP / SMTP email, and reply drafts requiring confirmation before sending.
- Image generation: new images from a configured image model, separate from original-image retrieval.
- Model choice: configured OpenAI-compatible, DeepSeek, Gemini, Cerebras, and Ollama integrations; feature support varies by provider.

## Student use cases and search vocabulary

AI for students; student AI assistant; AI study assistant; study companion; lecture notes assistant; PDF Q&A; course notes; revision assistant; exam preparation; study planner; assignment deadline reminder; student productivity; academic task management; focus assistant; study accountability; AI study tools; Pomodoro timer; academic email workflow.

## Implementation references

- [Agent tools](https://github.com/codehuang0717/OpenAlfred/blob/master/src/tools/__init__.py): registered capabilities.
- [Memory](https://github.com/codehuang0717/OpenAlfred/blob/master/src/tools/memory.py): long-term memory operations.
- [Knowledge retrieval](https://github.com/codehuang0717/OpenAlfred/blob/master/src/tools/rag.py): document search and image restoration.
- [Mini-app tools](https://github.com/codehuang0717/OpenAlfred/blob/master/src/tools/user_apps.py): standalone mini-apps and the separate todo-timeline panel.
- [Mini-app generation](https://github.com/codehuang0717/OpenAlfred/blob/master/src/services/code_apps.py): generation and source validation.
- [Voice calls](https://github.com/codehuang0717/OpenAlfred/blob/master/src/tools/call_user.py): SIP integration.
- [Model providers](https://github.com/codehuang0717/OpenAlfred/blob/master/src/services/llm.py): cloud and local model integration.

## Deployment context

Self-hosted application and storage; cloud model requests still go to the configured provider. Windows desktop capture and voice components have platform-specific requirements. Standalone generated mini-apps do not directly access private mail, memory, host files, or the network. This file is a readable project summary, not an API specification or a guarantee of support by any crawler.
